label: Evaluating a swap
subgoals: List the nets touching either swapped cell
Recompute their HPWL with the positions exchanged
Accept the swap only if the total change is negative

label: Shared nets and double counting
subgoals: Collect the union of nets of both cells
Evaluate shared nets with both cells moved at once
Deduplicate nets that appear more than once

label: Global swap and search strategy
subgoals: Target each cell's optimal region for swap candidates
Try vertical swaps with the rows above and below
Repeat passes until the gain per pass is small
